notes.title: NEW GAME MODE IS HERE
notes.content:
Can't get enough of They're Coming? Well today is your lucky day, we have added a new challenge mode with 2 new levels.

Unplugged: The televisions will be off at all times. Players must rely on sound cues in order to complete the level.

Dolly's Nightmare: A difficult challenge for the strongest of players. The only character you will face is Dolly  (we won't give too much of it away).

Stay tuned for more levels, as there will be more coming soon and don't forget

[b]They're Coming[/b]

notes.content: The newest update fixes the bug of Brenda's pies in level 2.
